concerns.text: FR-002 and US-1 acceptance scenarios require computing thermodynamic descriptors (mixing enthalpy, size mismatch, electronegativity variance) and verifying them via unit tests. Tasks T014 and T015 are marked 'FAILED: unspecified' with no concrete implementation details, and T010a/T010b (unit tests) are unchecked. This leaves the core feature engineering requirement unimplemented and unverified.

FR-003 and US-2 require an 80/20 train-test split and 5-fold cross-validation. Tasks T020 (split), T021 (CV training), and T022 (test evaluation) are unchecked or marked 'FAILED: unspecified', meaning the core modeling pipeline required to satisfy FR-003 and SC-002 is missing.

FR-001 and Edge Cases require specific error handling (logging to `data/logs/fetch_error.log`, `empty_dataset_error.log`) and exclusion logic for unknown labels. Tasks T008, T050, and T051 are unchecked, leaving the data ingestion pipeline without the required robustness and logging artifacts.

Constitution Principle I (Reproducibility) and Principle V (Versioning) require checksumming and reproducibility checks. Task T047 (Result Reproducibility Check) is unchecked and marked 'FAILED: unspecified', failing to provide the required hash verification mechanism.

Constitution Principle III (Data Hygiene) and IV (Single Source of Truth) require schema validation of all artifacts. Task T037 (Run validate_schemas.py) is unchecked, leaving the validation of data contracts unimplemented.

The plan requires an end-to-end pipeline execution. Tasks T061a through T061d (Atomic Pipeline Tests for Ingestion, Features, Training, Analysis) are unchecked, meaning the full pipeline execution and verification steps are missing.

Phase U requires execution of audit scripts (T046-T049) to populate audit logs. Tasks T065, T066, and T067 are unchecked, meaning the audit execution and logging required for compliance verification are missing.

FR-001 and Plan constraints require handling large datasets via streaming. Task T073 (Verification: Data Streaming) is unchecked, leaving the memory safety verification for large datasets unimplemented.
